entities.name: Leovold
entities.description: The Trestian ambassador in Paliano, an elf who gathers and trades information; he writes these dossiers and is himself the subject of one.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: The new queen of Paliano, whom Leovold sees as a predator who always aimed at the throne and has now begun to rule.

entities.name: King Brago
entities.description: The former ghost king of Paliano, now dead a second time.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: An earnest, hat-loving elven woman who drafted the Charter with Brago, was betrayed and imprisoned, and now considers striking back against the nobility.

entities.name: Adriana
entities.description: The former captain of the guard, a righteous rebel whose rallies and prison breaks cause unrest against Marchesa.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A goblin who was warden of Brago's prisons and now incites mobs and anarchy against the idea of the city.

entities.name: Lucia Covi
entities.description: An agent of Queen Marchesa who writes a dossier on Leovold and a report on the city's unrest.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: An academic whose artificial servants were replaced by exotic beasts used by Paliano's nobles.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The city in political turmoil as Marchesa consolidates power.

entities.name: Trest
entities.description: An elven city-state that sent Leovold as its ambassador to Paliano.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane on which Paliano is the greatest city.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: The ghostly clergy whose legitimization of Marchesa's crowning puzzles the citizens.

entities.name: Academy
entities.description: The now-disbanded institution whose former masters retreat to private workshops.

entities.name: Charter
entities.description: The Paliano charter that Selvala drafted alongside Brago and guided through ratification.

events.summary: Leovold notes that on the day of her ascension Marchesa decorated the throne room, guards and capital with Black Rose emblems, doubting her claim of Brago's will.
events.quote: the throne room is immediately decorated in Black Rose tapestries

events.summary: Leovold relays rumors that an assassin infiltrated the palace, possibly walking through walls, to kill Brago, and that the queen's crown now glows with his energy.
events.quote: an assassin infiltrated the palace, by some accounts walking through stone walls, in order to reach Brago's chambers.

events.summary: Leovold recounts that Selvala once drafted the Charter with Brago and was repaid with betrayal and imprisonment (backstory).
events.quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

events.summary: Leovold meets Selvala at a cafe, suggests a capable caretaker should rule, and promises her Trestian cousins' support.
events.quote: her cousins back in Trest would be extremely interested in supporting her in any of her future endeavors

events.summary: Leovold observes that Adriana barely survived the queen's ascension and expects emissaries to keep pressing her.
events.quote: She has only narrowly survived the queen's ascension

events.summary: Adriana rejects Leovold's overture; his messenger returns with a broken nose.
events.quote: the messenger returned with a broken nose and a completely ruined shirt.

events.summary: Leovold concludes that Marchesa's persona as mother of assassins was a distraction and the throne was always her target.
events.quote: The throne was always her target.

events.summary: Marchesa issues policies and proclamations drafted long before to consolidate power.
events.quote: Within hours of taking the throne, there have been proclamations and policies, clearly drafted weeks and months before.

events.summary: Leovold makes an official outreach to Marchesa on Trest's behalf.
events.quote: I have made an official outreach on Trest's behalf.

events.summary: Grenzo infiltrates Adriana's gatherings and turns peaceful demonstrations into violent mobs.
events.quote: He has twice now taken advantage of large gatherings assembled by Captain Adriana

events.summary: One of Leovold's attaches intercepts a dead drop containing the queen's dossier on Leovold.
events.quote: one of my diplomatic attachés interrupted a dead drop from one of the new queen's agents

events.summary: Lucia Covi reports to Marchesa on Leovold, his parties and the embassy's possible spying.
events.quote: I have gathered the following information regarding the recently appointed ambassador from the city-state of Trest.

events.summary: Leovold reports that Marchesa has replaced the city guard with loyal spies and assassins as she prepares to confront Adriana.
events.quote: The city guard has been largely thrown over in favor of troops loyal only to Marchesa

events.summary: Adriana stages prison breaks to bring her former guards back to her side while Grenzo abdicates his post.
events.quote: Adriana has managed to stage some rather daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side

events.summary: Leovold notes that Selvala and others look to exploit the unrest against the nobility.
events.quote: Some, including the illustrious and storied Selvala, are looking to take advantage of the unrest

relations.note: She signs as the Thorn of the Queen and writes to Her Majesty.
relations.quote: Lucia Covi, Thorn of the Queen

relations.note: She drafted the Charter with him, before later betrayal.
relations.quote: She drafted the Charter alongside Brago

relations.note: He was warden of Brago's prisons.
relations.quote: By serving as warden for Brago's prisons
how she managed to convince the Custodi to legitimize her crowning

relations.note: The queen gears up to confront the renegade captain.
relations.quote: as she gears up to confront the renegade Captain Adriana
